observations.text: Active development coordination: project-management.html and development.html; game root is now Project/ under the outer harness. Use python3 tools/manage_project.py status from the game root. The actual agentic loop is documented at agentic-loop.html and docs/59-agentic-development-loop.md. Every registered role defaults YES; each unused role needs an individual task-specific negation. Real selected host workers require authorization-before-spawn and actual distinct receipts. Execution owners -> WIK-30 actual game-wiki maintenance -> EVC-28 -> independent IA-11 -> DOC-10 process publication last. No agent runs afterward within that turn; late defects need a new authorized correction turn. The process JSON store does not replace this knowledge base. Imported history never invents past question/research rounds. Direct game-root CLI/local MCP work; current outer agents shortcut has an import-path defect. Configuration/local protocol success is not proof of live host connection (CONFIGURED_UNVERIFIED).

[The active agentic contract](59-agentic-development-loop.md), [management guide](../management/README.md) and [game-wiki loop page](../source_material/game-wiki/agentic-loop.html) now require every registered role to be considered, individual unused-role negations, actual authorized host workers, WIK-30 for the real game wiki, Collector → independent IA → Document Chief and matching accepted-publication slice closure. Historical self-review records are not rewritten as independent review. The CLI's original task/evidence mechanism remains alongside that loop. Current setup limitations, including the outer agents-shortcut import defect and unobserved live host MCP loading, are recorded in the active contract.
